newComponents.name: SlotPicker
newComponents.purpose: Let a booker pick one open session slot grouped by day with full states visible.
newComponents.whyNotExisting: RadioGroup and ChipGroup lack date grouping, two-week range structure, and full-versus-open slot states with seat counts.
newComponents.description: A date-grouped grid for the next two weeks that shows each day as a heading with its time slots as selectable pills in Figtree, soft radius, comfortable density. Open slots are selectable, full slots are muted and marked Full with a Tag, past slots are omitted. It stands out as the primary booking control on the public page, calm and scannable like the slot grids of a booking app.

newComponents.name: TimeInput
newComponents.purpose: Enter and validate a time of day for weekly availability windows.
newComponents.whyNotExisting: Input supports only text, tel, url and email types and has no time parsing, validation, or time affordance.
newComponents.description: A single time-of-day field showing HH:MM with a clock icon, soft radius, Figtree text, halo focus, and inline error like other inputs. Used in pairs for Available from and Available to in the availability form, calm and compact like the time fields of a calendar settings form.

the time field showing HH colon MM with clock icon
nodes.label: Time

questions.question: Do the different session types share one availability calendar, so a booked discovery call or design review blocks an overlapping workshop slot, and vice versa?
questions.whyItMatters: It changes which slots show as open or full on the public booking page and in upcoming sessions.
questions.defaultAnswer: Yes. Booking any session type blocks that time for the other session types, except that additional bookers can still join the same Figma workshop session until it reaches 8 people.

questions.question: Which time zone should bookers see slot times in?
questions.whyItMatters: It determines the timezone note and slot labels shown on the public booking page.
questions.defaultAnswer: The designer's own local time zone is used and shown on the booking page, with no time zone conversion for bookers.
